Grain Department

Dawson Grain Coop provides a competitive market for all your grain needs. We offer prices on grain delivered direct to our elevators and grain delivered direct to our area terminals. We can also pick up grain on the farm for your convenience.

Give us a call at 320-769-2929 for up-to-date bids (day or night) After hours press 2 for bids. If you would like to receive our daily email grain update, please give us a call or email our office at dgc@frontiernet.net. 

ALL BIDS ARE 10 MINUTE DELAYED AND SUBJECT TO CHANGE WITHOUT NOTICE
